title: Life Series Armour Remake
description: A Resource Pack that reimplements the appearance of the Life Series Armour by changing the Armour Model.
body:
This Resource Pack is a reimplementation of the armour from the Life Series, but instead of just replacing the textures of the original armour sets, it instead uses Entity Model Features and Entity Texture Features to replace the model of the armour itself. This allows it to work with any set of armour that's texture is in the vanilla style.

For any texture that is NOT in the vanilla style, it may look off, odd, or just flatout broken. This model change was designed specifically for armour that LOOKS like vanilla armour.
